inherit.use: Explicit opt-in: use the runtime's configured model and reasoning effort.

fast.use: Explicit low-effort opt-in for cheap, mechanical work; for direct runner use.

standard.use: Default: latest verified Sol with medium reasoning for bounded delegated tasks.

deep.use: Keep Sol and raise reasoning to high for complex logic, uncertain root causes or interacting components.

max.use: Keep Sol and use max reasoning for the hardest bounded problems; use --effort xhigh for the intermediate level.

image.use: Explicit Codex image-generation opt-in; the coordinator independently checks visual acceptance.
